definitions.gloss: why; how come; for what reason
definitions.explanation: A colloquial way to ask the reason for something. More casual than なぜ or どうして.

examples.japanese: なんで{来|こ}なかったの？
なんでそんなことを{言|い}うの？
examples.english: Why would you say something like that?

examples.japanese: なんで{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しようと{思|おも}ったんですか。
examples.english: Why did you decide to study Japanese?

notes:
USAGE:
The most casual of the three main "why" words. In order of formality: なぜ (formal/written) > どうして (neutral) > なんで (casual/spoken). Commonly used in everyday conversation, especially among friends and family.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なぜ: why — formal, used in writing and formal speech
- どうして: why, how — neutral formality, versatile
